notes.brief_deviation_spread: Brief formula matte' = min(1, matte / (1 - spread)) is NOT implemented: applied to the matte before the blur it is the identity for a binary layer alpha (so spread would do nothing), and applied after the blur it is a different model. Implemented instead the structure of Krita libs/image/layerstyles/kis_ls_drop_shadow_filter.cpp (read as a behaviour reference only, GPL, no code copied): spread_px = spread * size is grown as a hard disc dilation (Krita: Gaussian of spread_size then hard edge), blur_px = size - spread_px by Gaussian, then offset, then knockout. Spread 1 = hard matte grown by the full size; spread has no effect at size 0 (matches the Adobe community thread 'spread not working ... only shadows with hard edges'). Lead may reverse; only effect_math::reference_matte (DropShadow arm) and shadow_split change. Hand tests: tests/effects.rs drop_shadow_offset_blur_taps_and_spread.
notes.brief_acceptance_note_stroke: Acceptance 4 says the 8-neighbour ring is coverage 1 at distance 1. Under the Euclidean model the 12 edge-adjacent ring pixels are exactly 1 and the 4 corner pixels are 1.5 - sqrt(.5) = 0.79289 (round corners), 0 at distance >= 2; inside gives the 8-pixel inner ring exactly. Photoshop's outside-stroke corner shape is UNVERIFIED (D5 13).

semantics.inner_shadow: matte = 1 - alpha (beyond the plane = 1), choke_px = choke*size hard disc growth, blur = size - choke_px, offset like the drop shadow, then multiplied by alpha; placement over content
semantics.outer_glow: drop-shadow chain with zero offset and no knockout (spread*size growth, blur the rest); placement behind content
semantics.inner_glow: edge: inner-shadow chain with zero offset times alpha; centre: (1 - chain) times alpha (Krita inverts again after the blur for a centre source); placement over content
semantics.refused_typed: glow gradient fill, glow range other than 100 %, glow jitter above 0, Precise technique; domain errors (range outside (0,1], jitter outside [0,1], choke/spread outside [0,1]) win over refusals

wave2.ir_fields: OuterGlowOp / InnerGlowOp carry fill, technique, range, jitter faithfully from folio so composite maps 1:1 and pigment is the single place that refuses; composite passes jitter 0 for a colour glow only if the lead accepts the Tuts+ statement that jitter acts on gradients only (otherwise a colour glow with jitter > 0 is refused as glow_jitter)
sources: Krita libs/image/layerstyles/kis_ls_drop_shadow_filter.cpp: one pipeline for DropShadow, InnerShadow, OuterGlow, InnerGlow (alpha selection, invert when invertsSelection(), precise findEdge, spread = (spread*size+50)/100 then blur = size - spread, adjustRange when range != 100, centre source inverts again, contour, noise, offset, knockout, final composition); the choke uses the same spread slot (behaviour reference only, GPL, no code copied)
